crossRefs.note: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children…
Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of…
These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…

people.name: Elizur
people.line: A leader from the tribe of Reuben.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

people.name: Shedeur
people.line: Father of Elizur, a leader of Reuben

translations.web: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
translations.bsb: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.
translations.kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
translations.asv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
